title: GRC Practical Manuals: Multilingual Governance, Risk, Compliance, Privacy, and Cybersecurity Reference Collection
description: A multilingual educational reference collection covering governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, privacy, cybersecurity, audit and assurance, operational resilience, cloud and technology risk, third-party risk management, artificial intelligence governance, and related enterprise security disciplines. Editions are provided in English, neutral Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. Author and accountable human creator: Alberto “Al” Leiva. AI-assisted editorial and technical support: ChatGPT and Codex, OpenAI. AI assistance does not imply OpenAI review, certification, sponsorship, or endorsement.
